title: Great tour
text: We had a great day with our guide Bernat.  The hike from the top of the furnicular was harder than we expected but well worth it.  He was very knowledgeable about the mountain, the history and plant life.   I was apprehensive about going down some of the old rock stairs but Bernat was able to ease my fears and make me feel comfortable.  Everything was well organized and flexible to meet our interests and abilities.  Would highly recommend this tour and Bernat as a guide.

title: Highly recommend Catalans Trails!
text: We had a fabulous day out exploring the Montserrat monastery and hiking trails. Ramon, our guide, was amazing. Very knowledgeable and did a great job of showing us all the areas we were interested in. I would HIGHLY recommend Catalan Trails if you are looking for experienced and professional guides & adventures.
author: Corinneontheroad

title: Great hiking tour!
text: Fantastic hike and visit to the Monastery! Ramon was an excellent trip leader and a highly knowledgeable guide who shared fantastic information about the Geology, vegetation, history, and culture Monserrat. He even provided local snacks that were delicious. I highly recommend that you do this trip with Ramon.

title: Beyond Expectations!
text: Such a fabulous day spent with Ramon exploring Monserrat and waking down the hillside. Ramon is engaging and able to personalize the experience to guests interests and abilities. His knowledge surrounding the monastery and the mountain surroundings was palpable and made for a delightful cruise port experience that went beyond the average tourist activity. title: Mesmerized in Montserrat
text: The monastery is lovely, but my favorite part was hiking the trails and exploring the viewpoints. Geologically interesting, as well as historically influential. A rewarding day trip in every way.

title: Montserrat Tour with Ramon
